text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm waiting for a scrimmage to start when
I hear
some of the participants chatting
with each other.

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what it is... I just haven't
been able
to improve my time lately.

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
Tell me about it. I'll be glad if I don't
finish last
today...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, you two. ☆ It sounds like
you've lost
sight of your own marvelous
spark! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But don't you worry, because it's still
there—I can
see it plain as day! ☆ Let's
make this race a
marvelous one! ★

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text: Wha—huh? What's this now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, sorry about that. I've got her from
here.
Excuse us!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What's the big idea, Marvelous? Why
are you
talking up your opponents just
before the race?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanted them to notice the marvelous
effort
they've been putting in! ☆ Then
our race will be
marvelous too! ★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nerves are just a foreign concept to you,
huh?
Shouldn't you worry about yourself
first?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know you haven't been feeling the
greatest
lately.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No matter my condition, I'm always
marvelous! ☆ The sun might set
sometimes, but the stars are
always in
the sky! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So thanks, but don't worry about a
thing! ☆ Just
sit back and watch my
marvelous race! ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, it's time for the race to begin.
Under the watchful eyes of the
audience, the competitors
line up at the
starting gate, and the race begins!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Maintaining a steady pace near the
back, we have Marvelous Sunday! It's
still anybody's race at
this point—how
will this play out?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. She's definitely not in her best
condition. I
hope she doesn't hurt
herself...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha! ☆ Time to go into
marvelous
overdrive!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday rushes forward! In
barely a
moment, she's taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Take a good look, everyone! This is what
it means
to be maaarvelooous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's fast—and only getting faster! The
winning post is in sight... and Marvelous
Sunday maintains
her lead, handily
claiming first place!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you took first from so far
back. I don't know whether to be
impressed or worried at
how reckless you
are.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Did you feel it, Nature? ☆ Excitement,
passion,
joy—all that marvelousness has
filled the air! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But it's still not enough—not by a long
shot! ☆
Therefore, my marvelous running
must
continue! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
For it is my belief that the world can
always be
more marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... Right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday is approached by the
two
competitors she talked to before
the race. They
look excited.

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, what was that crazy dash
you did near the end? It was incredible!
You made me go
all out trying to keep
up!

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
How can we learn to run like you?
You've gotta
teach us! Please!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You don't have to run like me—you've been marvelous from the start! ☆ Once you realize that, dreams, goals—everything will fall into place! ★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I think they were looking for
something more
specific. You know, like
training techni—

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
I... I can feel my heart burning with
passion! Is this
what it means to be
marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it too! Marvelous!
Maaarvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's ☆ marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Ahahaha... I'll, uh, leave you
youngsters
to it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Find your own "marvelous," huh? If it'll
improve
my time, I guess it can't hurt to
try it out...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Marvelous. ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Nature! Welcome to the
world of
Marvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You heard that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday is approached by the
two
competitors she talked to before
the race.

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
You were really fast out there. I've never
seen
anyone dash like that before.

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
I had to push pretty hard to not eat your
dust...
Thanks. I almost forgot what that
felt like.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you hold onto that feeling,
'cause
that's what it means to be
marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You youngsters adapt quick, huh? Not
sure I can
keep up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, can't say I didn't feel a little
inspired by that
all-out dash.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Really?! All right! We'll get you fired up
and
feeling marvelous in no time,
Nature! ☆
